metadata.rules_text:
- Model consistently overestimates prices, especially after spikes or high volatility periods; apply downward bias correction by 5–15% for 3–7 day horizons post-spike.
- When sentiment history is flat (all 0.00), model exhibits overconfidence; reduce forecast magnitude by 3–8% for 10+ day horizons.
- After a sharp price spike (e.g., >40% from prior day), model fails to correct quickly; apply mean reversion heuristic: subtract 1–2 standard deviations from forecast if spike occurred in last 3 days.
- Forecasts for 30-day horizon show persistent overestimation of mid-term decline; adjust downward by 10–15% if true outcome shows early drop or sentiment turns negative.
- If sentiment history remains unchanged (all 0.00), assume no market sentiment shift; reduce forecast by 5–10% to account for lack of directional momentum.
